summary.text: PRETO ASKEVOLD ADVOKATFIRMA DA is a partnership with shared liability registered in Bergen, founded 1994-01-18. Preto Askevold Advokatfirma DA er et advokatfirma som driver advokatvirksomhet og det som naturlig står i forbindelse med dette, herunder eiendomsmeglervirksomhet. Selskapet driver også utleie av leid fast eiendom, herunder deler av egne lokaler. It was previously named PRETO ASKEVOLD & FEHR ADVOKATFIRMA ANS until 2023-03-16. Its main industry code is 69.100: legal activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 29 707 417 NOK and the annual result was 8 470 749 NOK; operating income was up from 26 472 383 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 9 173 787 NOK in 2024 to 8 470 749 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 3 702 182 NOK in 2024 to 3 003 784 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Rune Håkon Tjomsland (daglig leder). Its verified website is preto.no. The registered employee count went from 13 on 2026-02-13 to 16 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
